exclusions.reason: Tool installation/dependencies/cache, users/groups/roles, libraries, sharing/publishing, remote files, exports, storage, quotas, and server administration are outside the selected analyst lifecycle.
Workflow authoring and invocation are deliberately scoped to the captured 11-step IWC AMR template; arbitrary Galaxy workflows need their own source-grounded packs.
